segments.source: A BOOL value specifying whether Cinematic Video capture is supported.
segments.ko: Cinematic Video capture를 지원하는지 지정하는 `BOOL` 값입니다.

segments.source: With Cinematic Video capture, you get a simulated depth-of-field effect that keeps your subjects (people, pets, and more) in sharp focus while applying a pleasing blur to the background (or foreground).
segments.ko: Cinematic Video 캡처를 사용하면 피사체(사람, 반려동물 등)가 선명하게 초점이 맞춰진 상태를 유지하면서 배경(또는 전경)에 보기 좋은 블러를 적용하는 시뮬레이션된 심도 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Depending on the focus mode (see [`AVCaptureDevice.CinematicVideoFocusMode`](avcapturedevice/cinematicvideofocusmode.md) for detail), the camera either uses machine learning to automatically detect and focus on subjects in the scene, or it fixes focus on a subject until it exits the scene.
segments.ko: This message will be sent regardless of whether the session’s [`automaticallyRunsDeferredStart`](avcapturesession/automaticallyrunsdeferredstart.md) property is set.

segments.source: Cinematic Videos can be played back and edited using the Cinematic framework.
You can adjust the video’s simulated aperture before starting a recording using the [`simulatedAperture`](avcapturedeviceinput/simulatedaperture.md) property.
segments.ko: `[`simulatedAperture`](avcapturedeviceinput/simulatedaperture.md)` 속성을 사용해 녹화를 시작하기 전에 비디오의 시뮬레이션 조리개를 조정할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: With Cinematic Video specific focus methods on [`AVCaptureDevice`](avcapturedevice.md), you can dynamically control focus transitions.
segments.ko: [`AVCaptureDevice`](avcapturedevice.md)에서 Cinematic Video 전용 초점 메서드를 사용하면 초점 전환을 동적으로 제어할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Movie files captured with Cinematic Video enabled can be played back and edited with the [Cinematic framework] (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/cinematic/playing-and-editing-cinematic-mode-video?language=objc).
segments.ko: A capture device’s [`focusPointOfInterest`](avcapturedevice/focuspointofinterest.md) and [`exposurePointOfInterest`](avcapturedevice/exposurepointofinterest.md) properties provide a [`CGPoint`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreFoundation/CGPoint) value where `{0,0}` represents the top-left and `{1,1}` represents the bottom-right of the unrotated image.

segments.source: This property returns `true` if the session’s current configuration allows Cinematic Video capture.
segments.ko: The system takes the layer’s frame size and its [`videoGravity`](avcapturevideopreviewlayer/videogravity.md) into consideration when making the conversion.

segments.source: When switching cameras or formats, this property may change.
segments.ko: Use the [`fileDataRepresentation()`](avcapturephoto/filedatarepresentation().md) or [`cgImageRepresentation()`](avcapturephoto/cgimagerepresentation().md) method to obtain compressed image data.

segments.source: When this property changes from `true` to `false`, [`isCinematicVideoCaptureEnabled`](avcapturedeviceinput/iscinematicvideocaptureenabled.md) also reverts to `false`.

If you’ve previously opted in for Cinematic Video capture and then change configuration, you may need to set [`isCinematicVideoCaptureEnabled`](avcapturedeviceinput/iscinematicvideocaptureenabled.md) to `true` again.
segments.ko: 이전에 Cinematic Video 캡처를 사용 설정한 상태에서 구성을 변경한 경우 [`isCinematicVideoCaptureEnabled`](avcapturedeviceinput/iscinematicvideocaptureenabled.md)를 다시 `true`로 설정해야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: **Note**: [`AVCaptureDepthDataOutput`](avcapturedepthdataoutput.md) is not supported when [`isCinematicVideoCaptureEnabled`](avcapturedeviceinput/iscinematicvideocaptureenabled.md) is set to `true`.
Running an [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md) with both of these features throws an `NSInvalidArgumentException`.
segments.ko: 이 두 기능을 모두 사용해 [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md)를 실행하면 `NSInvalidArgumentException`이 발생합니다.

segments.source: A BOOL value specifying whether the Cinematic Video effect is being applied to any movie file output, video data output, metadata output, or video preview layer added to the capture session.
Shallow depth of field simulated aperture.
